change.before: "Waypoints required DNSProxy to be enabled in order to consume auto-allocated IPs"
change.after: "Waypoints consume auto-allocated IPs without requiring DNSProxy"

consequence.statement: Waypoints can now consume auto-allocated IPs even when DNSProxy is disabled. Before, this required DNSProxy to be enabled.
consequence.remediation: If you enabled DNSProxy only so waypoints could use auto-allocated IPs, check whether you still need it.

assertion.statement: In Istio 1.24.0, waypoints no longer need DNSProxy to be enabled to consume auto-allocated IPs.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not name the setting that enables DNSProxy or IP auto-allocation, or how waypoint use is detected, so no configuration predicate can be written from it.
